Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) to identify interacting partners of OTUD5. While the instrument is a Q Exactive HF (typically DDA), the text does not explicitly state the acquisition mode (DDA vs DIA). No labeling or quantification strategy is mentioned for the MS run. Although the paper focuses on ubiquitination, the MS part of the study was used for protein complex identification, not for ubiquitome/diGly remnant enrichment; PRIDE metadata explicitly states 'No PTMs are included in the dataset'.

scope: The nuclear extracts of the stable Flag-OTUD5/Hep3B cell line were prepared as described above and subjected to a Flag M2 immunoprecipitation. The affinity purified OTUD5-associated proteins were analyzed by liquid chromatography (LC)-MS/MS.
